title: Synthetic Kansas drought-planning exploration
purpose: Explore how a generalized planning surface could compare long-horizon water-demand, precipitation, and storage assumptions without predicting conditions or recommending action.

limitations: Synthetic values are supplied only to exercise the manifest shape.
No observed or forecast precipitation value is asserted.
No facility-level or operational storage fact is asserted.

assumptions.statement: The example compares only generalized demand-index changes and does not infer household, agricultural, municipal, or industrial demand.
The horizon is an exploratory comparison window and not a forecast interval.
The storage index is generalized and cannot support facility operations or emergency decisions.

equity_dimensions.description: Ask whether scenario assumptions could affect continuity of basic water service differently across generalized communities.
equity_dimensions.limitation: The fixture contains no community-level measurement or finding.

equity_dimensions.description: Ask whether cost burdens would need separate evidence before interpreting a scenario.
equity_dimensions.limitation: The fixture contains no household, ratepayer, or affordability data.

public_summary.heading: Synthetic Kansas water-planning scenario
